brewing.notes: A safe starting point for black tea: Western style, water just off the boil.

description:
A monsoon-picked black tea from the Sandakphu factory in Nepal.

Treat it as you would any black tea: water just off the boil, a few minutes in the pot, and a seller who can say where it was grown.
history: It was sold by Nepali Tea Traders and named best black tea at the North American Tea Championships in April 2015. Little more is documented about it.
processing: Oxidized slowly over several hours, then wood fired.
harvest_season: Picked during the monsoon, a season that tends to give plainer teas.
appearance_dry: Usually dark twisted leaf, sometimes with golden tips.
taste_profile: Complex, with a wild honey character.
vintage_note: Black teas are normally sold by harvest year and are best within a couple of years.
